workload.transaction_shape: one StateLedger row UPDATE + one graph epoch INSERT + one graph edge INSERT with V3 head trigger

schema_falsifier.reason: StateLedger defines meta(k,v) while ClayGraph base schema defines meta(key,value); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS silently retains the first incompatible table shape.
schema_falsifier.candidate_fix: namespace the ClayGraph generic metadata table as claygraph_meta(key,value); keep graph_* objects and UnifiedDB truth authority unchanged

interpretation.supported: On this matched local WAL/FULL workload, one physical SQLite commit domain is materially faster than two attached database files while preserving the tested logical state/graph outputs and injected rollback behavior.
interpretation.not_supported: Universal database superiority, target-host performance, or host-power-loss crash behavior.
